rawArchive.distributionDecision: lead-default-after-question-timeout: summaries and reproduction tools in Git, raw archive retained locally; no remote raw distribution

limitations: Raw source provenance is retained across collector-only fixes, not rewritten to the latest head.
Workers unsupported covers Tracing.start only, not every possible GC observation mechanism.
GC phase logs include warmup; exact GC interval attribution and source mapping limits are documented.
Same-host generator scaling does not prove independent server capacity.
No public raw download exists yet; audit commands require the preserved raw archive contents.
Historical Bun GC raw gcTraceSource label incorrectly says --trace-gc; actual JSC event source is authenticated by protocol/launch and corrected in derived metrics, without mutating raw bytes.
112 allocation snapshots with 531 dangling samples remain preserved but superseded by strictly validated recovery captures. Priming may include profiler serialization overhead after measured traffic.

Installed runtime metadata is separate from serving identity. Actual Bun1.4.2, Deno2.9.7, Node24.20.0 and workerd2025-06-04 are authenticated by saved subjects; earlier Bun1.4.0 serving claim was incorrect.
